conclusion: In GPT-2 small all four predictions hold at full precision (gpt2-local, gpt2-ndif). In the official Qwen3.8-27B screened in 4-bit on two 12 GB GPUs, 4 of 4 hold. At full precision on NDIF, 4 of 4 hold, which confirms the screen. So the same three-stage structure (the repeated name is tracked at S2, handed to the last token late in the network, and written out by a few backed-up attention heads) appears at about 220 times the size, at a similar relative depth. These are four coarse predictions, not the full 26-head circuit. An earlier NDIF run is kept in qwen27b-ndif-first-run: with only 6 prompts (a memory bug in glassbox, since fixed, limited the batch size) its behaviour check missed the accuracy threshold (0.50); the other three predictions held there too.
